links.outcome: Empirical coverage of conformal prediction uncertainty estimates versus 90% target across three LLMs
links.effect: GPT-4o and Claude Haiku showed empirical coverage of 97.1%; Mixtral-8x7B reached 95.7%, both above the 90% target. Risk labels LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH assigned per response.
links.quote: GPT-4o and Claude Haiku showed empirical coverage of 97.1%.

links.outcome: Calibration of GPT-4o token-level log-probability confidence (ECE)
links.effect: GPT-4o was miscalibrated (ECE = 0.213); token-level log probabilities are an unreliable confidence signal in clinical use.
links.quote: The calibration audit indicated that GPT-4o is miscalibrated (ECE = 0.213).

links.outcome: Model confidence change under eight input perturbations relative to semantic disruption
links.effect: Confidence barely changed, staying around 0.56–0.62, despite a twofold variation in semantic disruption, indicating systemic failure in self-assessment.
links.quote: Under perturbation audit across eight input modifications, confidence barely changed, staying around 0.56–0.62, despite a twofold variation in semantic disruption.

unlisted_practices: Conformal prediction with semantic-similarity nonconformity score to assign per-response hallucination risk labels

screen.reason: Evaluates a conformal prediction-based uncertainty quantification guardrail framework (ConfidentNeuro) applied to existing commercial LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude Haiku, Mixtral) for Alzheimer's clinical decision support.
